summary: Verified new full-page editor authoring flow (Purchase/SalesReceipt/Deposit/CreditMemo/RefundReceipt) end-to-end. Wrote 10 live-HTTP integration tests against the deployed backend covering the new GET /api/companies/{cid}/transactions/{tid} endpoint plus all 5 editor POST branches, sign-flip logic, CreditMemo bank-clear, unknown-txn-type ignore, quick-modal fallback, and cross-company isolation — all 10 passed. Re-ran the enumerated QBO mirror pytest suite (14 files) — 119/119 passed. Broader collection with -k filter across all mirror/editor tests: 127 passed. Frontend smoke: logged in as pro@axiom.ai, switched to Bright Beans Coffee Co., confirmed all 5 editor routes (/purchases/new, /sales-receipts/new, /deposits/new, /credit-memos/new, /refund-receipts/new) render with correct label chip, header fields, line-items table, memo/notes, and Save button. Save-flow validation correctly blocks empty submissions.

integration_issues.issue: Direct navigation to /transactions redirects to /dashboard for companies whose onboarding is incomplete (observed for both Bright Beans as pro@axiom.ai and TEST_dup as client@axiom.ai). Menu itself works — code inspection confirms all 6 dropdown entries (Quick manual entry + 5 QBO-shaped editors) with correct data-testids (txn-add-btn, txn-new-purchase, txn-new-sales-receipt, txn-new-deposit, txn-new-credit-memo, txn-new-refund-receipt). Could not exercise the dropdown at runtime because /transactions is gated by onboarding state — not a regression introduced by this iteration.

Playwright could not drive ContactCombobox and SearchableAccountPicker via generic [role=option] selectors — the pickers don't appear to expose role=option on their menu items. The editor renders fine and Save validation correctly rejects empty submissions ('Add at least one line item with a non-zero amount'). Manual/manual-agent testing recommended to fully exercise the Save→redirect flow; the backend contract itself is verified by the 10 live-HTTP tests (POST + follow-up GET verify server-side persistence).

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in Layout.jsx line ~359. Pre-existing; not introduced by editor work but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate ContactCombobox / SearchableAccountPicker to add role=option / data-testid=option on each menu item — will make future E2E automation of the Save flow reliable.
(Optional) Fix Layout.jsx hydration warning (span inside option, line ~359).

(Nice-to-have) Confirm /transactions gating behavior on non-onboarded companies is intentional. If yes, ensure the New Transaction menu is still reachable from /purchases, /sales-receipts, etc. or from the Dashboard for these accounts.
critical_code_review_comments: Editor payload branch in create_transaction cleanly gates on 6 known txn_type values — unknown values fall through to the qualifier path (verified by test_unknown_txn_type_ignored).
CreditMemo correctly nulls bank_account_id server-side even if editor payload includes one — verified live.
Sign-flip logic correct for all 5 types (Purchase -, SalesReceipt +, Deposit +, CreditMemo +, RefundReceipt -).
posted=True and human_reviewed=True stamped when editor payload used — matches CPA-authored-every-line semantics.

New GET /api/companies/{cid}/transactions/{tid} placed at bottom of transactions.py so literal paths (/transfer-pairs, /split-suggestion) still match first. Returns {transaction: coerce(doc)} which excludes _id. 404 for unknown tid; 404/403 for cross-company via require_company.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 new live + 119/119 enumerated + 127/127 broader QBO/editor filter)
success_rate.frontend: route rendering: 5/5 editors + menu code-verified; automated Save round-trip: blocked by shared-component selector gaps (see integration_issues)

seed_data_creation: Test contact created on demand in Bright Beans (TEST_Contact_<hex>) via /api/companies/{cid}/contacts. Multiple TEST_-prefixed transactions created via editor POST branch (all left in place for future audit; can be swept with description prefix TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live-HTTP tests at /app/backend/tests/test_editor_endpoints_live.py cover all 5 editor branches + new GET endpoint. Uses pro@axiom.ai and creates a contact on demand if none exists. If seeding changes and Skyward becomes accessible under pro user, the fixture will prefer it automatically. Frontend Save round-trip could not be automated because ContactCombobox/SearchableAccountPicker don't expose role=option; next agent may want to add data-testid=account-option-<id> / contact-option-<id> to those shared components before attempting the full-page editor E2E.
